entries.title: MYRIAD
entries.author: Rob Sanders
entries.currentBlurb: The Alpha Legion's myriad schemes converge as the Siege approaches.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The XX Legion's countless operations reach critical junctures.

entries.title: THE GREY RAVEN
entries.author: Gav Thorpe
entries.currentBlurb: A Raven Guard warrior fights in the shadows before the Siege.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The XIX Legion strikes from darkness in the war's final days.

entries.title: VALERIUS
entries.author: Gav Thorpe
entries.currentBlurb: A warrior named Valerius faces his destiny as the Siege looms.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: One man's courage is tested in the war's final moments.

entries.title: THE EMBER WOLVES
entries.author: Rob Sanders
entries.currentBlurb: Space Wolves burn with fury as they race toward Terra.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The VI Legion's wrath drives them toward the Throneworld.

entries.title: BLACKSHIELD
entries.author: Chris Wraight
entries.currentBlurb: A warrior without allegiance fights his own war before the Siege.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: Blackshield Space Marines wage their own battles in the Heresy's final days.

entries.title: CHILDREN OF SICARUS
entries.author: Anthony Reynolds
entries.currentBlurb: Word Bearers from Sicarus march toward Terra to see their dark vision fulfilled.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The XVII Legion advances on the Throneworld with dark purpose.

entries.title: EXOCYTOSIS
entries.author: James Swallow
entries.currentBlurb: The Death Guard's corruption reaches horrific new depths.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: Nurgle's gifts transform the XIV Legion into plague-bearers.

entries.title: THE PAINTED COUNT
entries.author: Guy Haley
entries.currentBlurb: A Blood Angels noble fights to maintain his Legion's honor.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The IX Legion struggles with their nature as the Siege approaches.

entries.title: THE LAST SON OF PROSPERO
entries.author: Chris Wraight
entries.currentBlurb: The last loyal son of Prospero fights for redemption before Terra burns.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: A Thousand Sons warrior seeks to atone for his Legion's fall.

entries.title: THE SOUL, SEVERED
entries.author: Chris Wraight
entries.currentBlurb: Souls are severed from bodies as the warp's influence grows.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: Reality frays at the edges as Chaos power intensifies.

entries.title: DARK COMPLIANCE
entries.author: John French
entries.currentBlurb: Worlds are brought to dark compliance by the traitor forces.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The traitors force worlds to submit through terror and corruption.

entries.title: DUTY WAITS
entries.author: Guy Haley
entries.currentBlurb: Imperial Fists stand ready on Terra, knowing their duty awaits.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The VII Legion prepares to defend humanity's cradle.

entries.title: MAGISTERIUM
entries.author: Chris Wraight
entries.currentBlurb: The Custodians prepare for the defense of the Emperor himself.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The Emperor's golden guardians ready themselves for the ultimate battle.

entries.title: NOW PEALS MIDNIGHT
entries.author: John French
entries.currentBlurb: Midnight arrives as the traitor fleet emerges at Terra. The Siege begins.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The darkest hour strikes as Horus's forces arrive at the Throneworld.

entries.title: DREAMS OF UNITY
entries.author: Nick Kyme
entries.currentBlurb: Dreams of unity die as the Heresy reaches its terrible climax.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The Emperor's dream shatters as war comes to Terra.

entries.title: THE BOARD IS SET
entries.author: Gav Thorpe
entries.currentBlurb: The Emperor and Malcador play a final game as the pieces move into place. The board is set, the Siege begins, and the fate of humanity hangs in the balance.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The Emperor and Malcador reflect on the coming battle as the traitors arrive. The endgame begins.
